title: The Vowels Before the Shift
subtitle: Long a = 'ah', long i = 'ee', long u = 'oo' — not yet modern.
objectives: Master The Vowels Before the Shift.
Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The Great Vowel Shift has not yet happened. Long a = 'ah' (name = NAH-muh). Long e = 'ay' (sweet = SWAYT). Long i = 'ee' (fyre = FEE-ruh). Long o = 'oh' (good = GOHD). Long u = 'oo' (hous = HOOS). Short vowels closer to modern. You must unlearn modern pronunciation to hear Chaucer.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
